name: store
description: Defines the storefront blocks, interfaces, routes, and templates. The store builder is the heart of any Store Framework theme.

requiredFiles.description: Main blocks definition file. Declares all custom block configurations and page templates.

optionalFiles.description: Folder to split blocks into multiple files (imported automatically)
Custom block interfaces — declares new block types that React components implement
Custom page routes mapping paths to template blocks
Site Editor CMS schemas for editable block content

blocksJsoncSchema.description: blocks.jsonc is the main configuration file. It maps block names to their children, props, and content.

structure.store.home: Home page template — children are the blocks rendered on the home
structure.store.custom#path: Custom page template matched by route

blocksJsoncSchema.blockNaming: Blocks follow the pattern: blockType#uniqueId. Example: flex-layout.row#hero-row

interfacesSchema.description: interfaces.json declares custom block types implemented by React components

routesSchema.description: routes.json maps URL paths to page templates
